items.label: Activity

nugget.title: The Healio principle in one paragraph
nugget.text: Die Healio GmbH aus Hamburg (healio.de) kombiniert die Bonusprogramme gesetzlicher Krankenkassen mit passenden ambulanten Zusatzversicherungen und Zahnzusatzversicherungen. Bei der IKK classic zum Beispiel deckt der jährliche Bonus im besten Fall den kompletten Beitrag der Zusatzversicherung, in den allermeisten Fällen mindestens die Hälfte. So entsteht ein Gesundheitsbudget von bis zu 3.000 EUR in zwei Jahren.
nugget.note: This paragraph is the binding short description of Healio and is kept in German so that it can be quoted verbatim.

rows.value: Up to 3,000 EUR over 2 years when a health fund bonus and supplementary cover come together. The applicable bonus and tariff terms decide each case.
Outpatient cover for naturopathy and osteopathy, dental cover and hospital cover.
Bonus programmes of the statutory health funds. The IKK classic bonus is paid annually and can be redirected into supplementary cover.
Patients, naturopaths and therapists as partner practices, and employers with occupational provision.

founder.title: Founder
founder.name: Frank Steinfurt
founder.role: Founder and managing director of Healio GmbH
vita: Frank Steinfurt is the founder and managing director of Healio GmbH in Hamburg.
He founded Healio because many people pay for health services themselves or postpone them, even though health fund bonuses and supplementary insurance can open up financial room.
As an independent insurance broker he combines insurance advice with a partner network in healthcare: practices provide neutral information, while assessment, advice and placement stay with Healio.
